articles.summary: TOANO, Va., July 22, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - CF Financial Corporation (the Corporation) (NASDAQ: CFFI), the holding company for CF Bank, is pleased to announce its expansion into the Lynchburg market and welcomes Ryan White as its new Market Executive . This addition underscores CF’s commitment to providing outstanding service and building strong relationships with businesses and communities throughout the Commonwealth. A highly respected banker with more than two decades of experience, Ryan brings deep local market knowledge, extensive commercial banking expertise, and strong relationships across the communities in and around Lynchburg, Virginia. articles.title: C&F Announces Expansion into Lynchburg Market
